:::{#exm-logical-argument}
#### A logical argument
<!-- no-figure: three short sentences; nothing to plot -->

"If $n$ is [even](number-systems.qmd#def-even-odd), then $n^2$ is even.
$n$ is even.
So $n^2$ is even."
is a [logical argument](#def-logical-argument).
Its [premises](#def-premise) are
"if $n$ is even, then $n^2$ is even"
and "$n$ is even".
Its [conclusion](#def-conclusion) is "$n^2$ is even".

:::
